set.body: Update PRD.md and eyes4s.md with the settled visual-world architecture: planned versus observed timelines and fitted SyncEvidence; entity-primary AOI traces with pure role/construal projection; estimand-indexed result types; policy-specific spatial accounting; serializable anchor selectors and final-bin policy; conditional versioned codecs for generic user types; corrected v0.5/v0.6/v0.65 prerequisites and a deferred eyes4s-vwp consumer module.
